sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: An old friend came to visit, and the conversation turned to family, memories, and keeping in touch. Dina said, “How is your family doing?” His friend replied, “Everyone is doing well.” Dina said, “I have a close family.” His friend replied, “My parents live in another city.” Dina said, “I call them every week.” His friend replied, “My brother likes football.” Dina said, “My sister enjoys reading.” His friend replied, “We try to meet on weekends.” Dina said, “I miss spending time with them.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Dina said, “Family gatherings are special to me.” His friend replied, “My cousin is coming tomorrow.” Dina said, “We grew up together.” His friend replied, “He has a great sense of humor.” Dina said, “My friend lives nearby.” His friend replied, “We have known each other for years.” Dina said, “We share many interests.” His friend replied, “Can I introduce you to my friend?” Dina said, “It is a pleasure to meet you.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Dina said, “How long have you been friends?” His friend replied, “We met at university.” Dina said, “We help each other when needed.” His friend replied, “A good friend listens carefully.” Dina said, “I appreciate your advice.” His friend replied, “Thank you for checking on me.” Dina said, “Would you like to join us?” His friend replied, “We are having dinner together.” Dina said, “Please say hello to your family.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Dina said, “I will pass on your greetings.” His friend replied, “Let us keep in touch.” Dina said, “Send me a message when you arrive.” His friend replied, “I am happy to see you again.” Dina said, “We had a wonderful evening.” His friend replied, “Our friendship means a lot to me.” Dina said, “I hope we meet again soon.” They felt more confident after practising together.
